title: [Dataverse] Use commercial endpoints in Business Central online
summary: Business Central online now always uses commercial Dataverse endpoints regardless of the selected cloud, while on-premises continues to respect the selected Dataverse Cloud setting for sovereign cloud scenarios.
key_points: GetDataverseCloudEndpoints() returns Commercial endpoints when running in SaaS infrastructure
On-premises installations still respect the selected Dataverse Cloud value for GCC High and other sovereign clouds
All callers already use the GetDataverseCloudEndpoints() method so the change is centralized
Updated documentation to clarify the cloud selection only applies on-premises
New test validates that SaaS ignores Dataverse Cloud overrides and resolves to commercial endpoints
